Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The grill seems to be well made (in China) and was relatively easy to assemble with basic tools. The instructions were almost too detailed and the added steps for details that were seemed obvious or intuitive extended the amount of time it took to put it together. I'm not crazy about the way the propane tank hangs from the scale. It's tricky to mount for anyone with back issues and the one area where there were no instructions. Once assembled the grill fired up immediately and we were surprised how much faster it warmed up and how much hotter it got than our old four burner grill. Granted its new, but it burns so cleanly, it's difficult to tell if it's on. So far, we are very pleased with the performance and feel the price premium for a Weber was worth it. If I could suggest an improvement it would be to add a set of casters or wheels to the two stationary legs. It's a bit of a handful to wheel around and that shelf isn't much of a handle.
Results.Title: The Heat Is On

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
